title: Oven Smoked Dutch Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring sweet smoked paprika, perfect for a cozy evening meal. This dish is Whole30-friendly and packed with herbal notes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the pork cubes with the sweet smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and add the pork cubes, browning on all sides.
Remove the browned pork from the pot and set aside, then add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the chopped carrots, potatoes, and celery to the pot, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional minute.
Add the beef broth to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the browned pork to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.
